description: Automate account creation on any target domain during bug-bounty work, end to end: disposable-inbox creation with the agent-email CLI (the core inbox methodology — https://github.com/zaddy6/agent-email), browser-driven signup forms (React, Knockout, Headless-UI, react-select, intl-tel-input, Knockout wizards), email verification (links or codes), onboarding completion incl. file-upload walls, and session capture. Use whenever the user wants to "sign up", "create an account", "register", "get credentials for", or "use" a target domain while hunting — even mid-campaign when a surface is blocked by missing credentials. Also handles blocker taxonomy: reCAPTCHA gates, IP-flagged signups, region gates — with the exact handoff to ask the user for.
